title: EFC Background No-Go Theorem: Why Background-Level Modification Cannot Suppress Structure Growth
description: Shows that any EFC background-level modification to H(z) large enough to improve DESI DR1 BAO fits is decisively ruled out by Planck 2018 CMB distance priors. Using three independent parametrisations (linear α·T(a), exponential Geff = G0 exp(aG S(a)), and regime-aware piecewise H), the paper demonstrates a structural BAO–CMB tradeoff and concludes the EFC background is effectively ΛCDM at current precision, redirecting EFC to the perturbation sector.

modified_friedmann_linear.description: Linear background coupling tested against CMB+BAO; α controls late-time modification localized to z < 1.

exponential_geff.description: Exponential coupling to the entropy sigmoid S(a) (center a_t, width \sigma) producing localized z < 1 background changes.

bao_cmb_distances.description: BAO and CMB distance measures; BAO constrains D_M/r_d and D_H/r_d, while CMB distance priors constrain D_A(z_*).

cmb_priors.description: Planck 2018 CMB distance prior summary parameters used in the joint fits.

da_split_integral.description: Even with regime separation (unmodified early-time physics), D_A(z_*) integrates through the modified low-z regime, enforcing the BAO–CMB tradeoff.

key_results.main_finding: Any EFC background H(z) modification large enough to improve BAO (Δχ2_BAO ≲ −5) is decisively excluded by CMB distance priors, yielding Δχ2_total > 0; the EFC background is effectively ΛCDM at current precision.
datasets_used: DESI DR1 BAO (14 points: DM/rd, DH/rd, 0.3 < z < 2.3)
Planck 2018 CMB distance priors (ℓa, R) at z* = 1089.92

sealed_predictions.statement: For Planck 2018 distance priors combined with DESI DR1 BAO, any background-only EFC model f(S(a)) that achieves Δχ2_BAO ≤ −5 at z < 1 will incur Δχ2_CMB ≥ +10, giving Δχ2_total > 0.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Finding a background-only EFC fit to the stated datasets with Δχ2_total ≤ 0 relative to ΛCDM.

sealed_predictions.statement: A ≈2–3% fractional change in H(z) near z ≈ 0.5 necessarily induces a ≥0.2–0.4% shift in D_A(z*) that Planck-quality data detect at ≥5σ.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A jointly consistent reconstruction showing δH/H ≳ 2% at z ~ 0.5 with δD_A/D_A < 0.1% using Planck-equivalent CMB distance precision.

kill_criteria: KC1: Demonstrate a background-only EFC model (no perturbation-sector changes) that improves DESI DR1 BAO by Δχ2_BAO ≤ −5 while keeping Planck 2018 distance priors within Δχ2_CMB ≤ +5 (i.e., Δχ2_total ≤ 0).

KC2: Independent reconstruction of H(z) from cosmic chronometers and time-delay lenses showing a ≥2% deviation at 0.3 < z < 1 that is simultaneously consistent with Planck-level D_A(z*) constraints (|δD_A|/D_A < 0.1%).

KC3: Evidence that the entropy sigmoid S(a) or gate function effectively modifies physics at recombination (S(z*) ≠ 0) as inferred from primary CMB spectra, contradicting the regime separation assumed by EFC.
KC4: A robust BAO analysis forward-modeled with EFC perturbations (µ=Σ=1 fixed) that attributes the observed BAO preference to background-only changes without incurring the predicted CMB penalty.

analytical.name: Sign Lemma
analytical.statement: ΔE²(z) = A·[g(z) − g(0)] ≤ 0 for all z > 0
analytical.proof: Under closure normalisation E(0) = 1, the gate g(z) is monotonically decreasing for z > 0 (activates at late times). Therefore g(z) ≤ g(0) for all z > 0, and with A > 0, ΔE² ≤ 0.
analytical.corollary: H_EFC(z) ≤ H_ΛCDM(z) → reduced Hubble friction → enhanced structure growth
analytical.implication: Background-level EFC structurally excluded for σ₈ suppression

numerical.name: CLASS v3.3.4 Verification
numerical.conclusion: Growth is enhanced at all redshifts — opposite direction from S₈ tension amelioration

architectural_consequence.reason: Sign lemma proves background enhancement; observational α-collapse confirms emptiness
testable_predictions: All testable by Euclid DR1/DR2 (2026–2028) and DESI DR3 (~2027–2028)

falsification_criteria.condition: Mechanism found where ΔE² > 0 with E(0) = 1
falsification_criteria.implication: Sign lemma violated; requires non-monotonic gate

falsification_criteria.condition: α ≠ 0 detected at > 3σ in CMB + BAO joint fit
falsification_criteria.implication: Background gate not empty; observational pillar fails
